class.name: StallDetector
class.description: STALL classifier: /motor/safety_state contains "stall" in the look-back window (controller WARN_STALL_* / FAULT_stall_*). Fail-open empty window.

class.name: SlipDetector
class.description: SLIP classifier: mean |/odom| wheel speed high while /gps/fix GNSS displacement stays low (status-tier thresholds). Fail-open incomplete data.

class.name: CostmapBlockedDetector
class.description: COSTMAP classifier: local costmap OccupancyGrid has high occupancy near the robot. Fail-open if map/pose stale. Unknown cells are not blocked.

class.name: RecoveryAnnounce
class.description: Log + /recovery/active_branch when a recovery structure starts (STALL / SLIP / COSTMAP / UNKNOWN). Always SUCCESS.
